remarks: Enjoy life in this sun filled townhome ideally located close to Metro North and just moments to dining, shopping,beaches and all that Westport has to offer!! A charming wraparound front porch welcomes you into the bright and airy foyer.The spacious living room offers newly refinished hardwood floors, a fireplace, vaulted ceiling, a dining area and sliders leading to the private patio. A beautifully updated eat in-kitchen features quartz countertops, porcelain tile backsplash and new tile flooring as well as stainless appliances and skylights. A half bath and laundry complete this level. Upstairs you will find the primary suite with a vaulted ceiling, sliders to a private balcony/deck, a dressing area with two closets and a large, updated master bath. The secondary bedroom offers built in bookcases,a vaulted ceiling and a renovated en-suite bath. Freshly painted throughout and an attached one car garage. So much to love here!
